:::{#exm-not-finitely-additive}
#### Squaring the count is not finitely additive

On the same $\sigma$-algebra, let $\measureb(A) \eqdef \abs{A}^2$.
The sets $\set{1}$ and $\set{2}$ are pairwise disjoint, but

$$
\ba
\measureb(\set{1} \cup \set{2})
&= \measureb(\set{1, 2})
&& \text{(take the union)} \\
&= 2^2 \\
&= 4,
&& \text{(count, then square)} \\
\measureb(\set{1}) + \measureb(\set{2})
&= 1^2 + 1^2 \\
&= 2,
&& \text{(count each set, then square)}
\ea
$$

and $4 \ne 2$, so $\measureb$ is not finitely additive.

:::
